- Before AI, Aayush worked in game development (2020 – 2024): Unity, hypercasual games, AR games and independent prototypes.

### AI Research Intern — AI Institute of South Carolina (Sep 2024 – Sep 2025)
Under: Prof. Amitava Das
Location: Columbia, SC (Remote)

Key work:
- Worked on extending the AQI framework (published: EMNLP 2025) from text
  LLMs to image generation models.
- AQI applies geometric clustering indices (Davies-Bouldin, Dunn,
  Calinski-Harabasz) to model activations as an intrinsic alignment
  diagnostic, moving beyond behavioral refusal-rate proxies.
- Applied this framework to diffusion model latent spaces: SD2.1, SDXL, Flux.
  Tested whether safe/unsafe prompt activations exhibit measurable geometric
  separation in image models the same way they do in LLMs.
- Ran brief exploratory experiments on autoregressive image generation models.
- Contributed to RLHF preference dataset construction and evaluation pipeline
  design.
- Implemented the "Stable Diffusion Is Unstable" paper and adapted it to newer
  diffusion models. Details under Research & Publications.
- Note: The AQI extension paper did not ship. Involvement concluded September 2025.

Reference paper (group's published work): "Alignment Quality Index (AQI):
Beyond Refusals" — EMNLP 2025. Authors include Prof. Amitava Das et al.
Aayush's contribution was the extension to image generation models.

## Research & Publications

### Spoken or Typed (2026, independent)
Measures speed and meaning errors of AI dictation against a keyboard, using
Whisper speech-to-text and LLM cleanup on 300 synthetic-voice messages. 36% of
glanced dictated messages carry a major meaning change, vs 9–11% for typing. A
router sends the riskiest 40% of messages to the keyboard and halves shipped
errors for a skilled typist, at 12% of the speed. Limits: synthetic speech, no
human judge labels, no real users.
GitHub: https://github.com/gamedevCloudy/spoken-or-typed

### Decomposing a Large Decision into a DAG of Small Jev Calls (2026, independent)
Tests the error and cost of splitting a large decision into a DAG of small calls
to Jev, TypeSafe AI's typed decision model. In a short support test, the chain
and DAG matched one more answer than a single flat call, short of the two the
rule required, and cost more, so the flat call stays. Does not test a large
decision or a decision-tree branch.
GitHub: https://github.com/gamedevCloudy/jev-decision-trees

### Stable Diffusion Is Unstable: implementation and adaptation (2024 – 2025, AISC)
Implemented the 2023 paper "Stable Diffusion Is Unstable"
(https://arxiv.org/abs/2306.02583), tested on SD 1.5 and Flux.1 Schnell. In
early 2025, adapted it to SDXL and other newer diffusion models, and released
a dataset of adversarial Stable Diffusion prompts.
- 2024 implementation: https://github.com/gamedevCloudy/Stable_Diffusion_is_Unstable
- 2025 adaptation: https://github.com/gamedevCloudy/atm-attack
- Dataset: https://huggingface.co/datasets/aayush-cloudy/adversarial-sd-prompts

### Agent Laboratory (2025, code contribution)
Added Ollama support to Agent Laboratory (LLM agents as research assistants),
so it can run on local models. Code contribution only; not part of the paper.
- Pull request: https://github.com/SamuelSchmidgall/AgentLaboratory/pull/76
- Paper: https://arxiv.org/pdf/2501.04227

### IEEE GC4T 2025 (Published)
Title: Advanced Knowledge Representation using GNN-GAT Hybrids
Contribution: Proposed KeGNN, a knowledge-enhanced graph neural network
combining GNN message passing with GAT attention mechanisms.
Result: 4.2% gain over standard GAT baseline.
Dataset: PubMed-derived biomedical knowledge graph datasets.
Context: Published as part of B.E. final year thesis at SPPU.
Implementation: https://github.com/Copper-Second-Brain/meta-gat

### AQI Extension to Image Models at AISC (2024 – 2025, unpublished)
Focus: Latent-space alignment diagnostics for image generation models.
Details: See the AI Institute of South Carolina role under Professional Experience.

## Selected Projects

### AIMI: AI Maturity Index
Type: Production SaaS (built at the bootstrapped startup, Jul 2025 – Aug 2026)
Stack: SvelteKit, FastAPI, pydantic-ai, OpenRouter, Turso (LibSQL),
       Upstash Redis, GCP Cloud Run, Bun, UV
Details: Multi-tenant enterprise platform for measuring organizational AI
adoption readiness. 30-question conversational assessment across 6 dimensions.
Grounded in 17 company case studies.
Architecture:
- Three services: aimi-cms (admin), aimi-client-side (survey), aimi-ai (backend)
- Multi-agent AI pipeline: discovery and benchmark quiz agents, per-employee
  scoring with a confidence gate (>=7 required), and a modular research agent
  (planner -> synthesizer -> judge)
- Report generation via a single Claude Sonnet 4.6 call (~$0.80/report,
  30-60 seconds)
- Redis for quiz session state (24h TTL): 1 Turso write per quiz instead of 30+
- Single migration authority (packages/db) to prevent schema conflicts
- Models used: Claude Sonnet 4.6, OpenRouter (GPT-4, Gemini, DeepSeek fallbacks)
Metrics: load-tested at 100 concurrent users with 0% error rate, p95 latency ~6s
Scale: Multi-tenant, serving enterprise clients

### AskCava
Type: Production RAG agent
Client: Cava Athleisure
Stack: FastAPI, LangChain, GPT-4, ChromaDB, SQLite
Details: Conversational product recommendation agent with gender-specific
retrieval over a 750+ item catalog (grown from 500+ at launch). Approximately
2,500 monthly active users. ChromaDB embeddings split by gender. Pydantic-
validated API output. Dense retrieval improved recommendation accuracy by 85%
over a keyword-search baseline.

### LLM Attention Visualizer
Type: Research/interpretability tool
Stack: PyTorch, Flask
Details: Tool for visualizing Llama 3.1 attention patterns across layers
and heads. Built for mechanistic interpretability research. Renders multi-head
heatmaps for any input sequence. A scoped-down DistilBERT version was built for presentation: https://github.com/gamedevCloudy/attention-visualization

### RTX-Zig
Type: Systems/graphics project
Stack: Zig
Details: CPU-based ray tracer written from scratch in Zig. Covers BVH
acceleration, material shaders (Lambertian, metal, dielectric), and
anti-aliasing. Built as a low-level systems exercise.

### Flipkart MinutesOfTheMeeting.ai
Type: Enterprise production system (built as an intern at the bootstrapped startup)
Stack: FastAPI, Python, PostgreSQL, Redis, Google OAuth, Whisper
Details: Meeting transcription and intelligence platform for Flipkart.
Eliminated 400+ hours/month of manual note-taking. Improved speaker diarization
accuracy by 40%.
Write-up: https://aayushdev.xyz/posts/time-when-i-worked-with-flipkart/

### Travenza AI
Type: Production AI pipeline
Client: Travenza Holidays (premium travel)
Stack: FastAPI, Google ADK, Gemini, ChromaDB, SvelteKit, pptxgenjs
Details: 5-agent orchestration generating complete travel itineraries
in PPTX format. Reduced proposal creation from about 4 hours to about
5 minutes. Win rate improved from 28% to 40%.

### Hinglish Captions
Type: SaaS product
Stack: React, TypeScript, Express, FastAPI, Gemini, Razorpay, FFmpeg
Details: Hindi-English bilingual video captioning and SRT generation platform
with subscription-based access control. Captioning a video went from 2-3 hours
of manual work to 10-15 minutes of review.

## Open Source Contributions

### NousResearch/hermes-agent — PR #267 (Merged)
URL: https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/267
Contribution: Added DuckDuckGo search as a fallback skill for when Firecrawl
is unavailable. Supports text, image, news, and video search via the ddgs
library. Integrates with the OpenRouter API.

### NousResearch/hermes-agent — PR #178 (Merged)
URL: https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/178
Contribution: Fixed PATH detection in the install script. The original function
matched commented-out lines as valid PATH entries, causing setup to silently
skip adding hermes to PATH.

### google/adk-python — Issue #15 (Closed, fixed)
URL: https://github.com/google/adk-python/issues/15
Contribution: Reported text overflow bug in ADK Web when the model outputs
long strings. Acknowledged by the Google ADK team same day. Fixed and shipped
in the following release.

### raycast/extensions — PR #25696 (Merged, live in Raycast Store)
URL: https://github.com/raycast/extensions/pull/25696
Contribution: Fixed API rate limit exhaustion in the Toggl Track extension.
Increased menu bar refresh interval from 10s to 3min, added 30s cache TTL.
Reduced API calls from ~360/hr to ~20/hr.
